card.name: Step, figure and section numbers
card.fires_on: Small digits (mostly 2 to 6) that number a step, figure, footnote or section reference in label text, such as "Step 4", "Figure 6" or "(2.5)". Also fires on a few ordinal or dose digits.

modes.label: Step and figure numbers
modes.description: A digit labelling a step or figure in an instruction sequence.

modes.label: Section and footnote numbers
modes.description: A digit in a numbered list, footnote or cross-reference like (2.5).

card.plain: It marks a small number that labels a step, figure, footnote or section in a drug label.
